# Frank / Blog

> Public writing about data, interfaces, AI, and interaction.

## Public content

- [English blog](https://blog.songhai.site/)
- [中文博客](https://blog.songhai.site/zh/)
- [Public content index](https://blog.songhai.site/api/search-index.json): JSON records include each note and project's type, readable URL, Markdown URL, and Markdown content.
- [Sitemap](https://blog.songhai.site/sitemap.xml): canonical public HTML pages.

## Reading a post

Article pages are available as readable HTML. Each article also has a sibling `.md` URL and declares that URL with `rel="alternate"` and `type="text/markdown"` in its HTML head.
